name: resorcinol + sulfur
uses: stop use and ask a doctor if skin irritation occurs or gets worse
otcwarn: Warnings for external use only. when using this product: skin irritation and dryness is more likely to occur if you use another topical acne medication at the same time. rinse right away with water if it gets in eyes. do not use on broken skin or large areas of the skin. when using this product apply only to areas with acne.
